what_is.heading: What is Breast Augmentation? Enhancing Your Silhouette
paragraphs: Breast augmentation is one of the most popular cosmetic surgery procedures, designed to increase breast size, improve symmetry, and enhance overall body proportions. At LUNAI, we help you achieve the beautiful, natural-looking curves you desire, boosting your confidence and helping you feel more comfortable in clothing.

options.heading: Your Options: Implants and Fat Transfer
paragraphs: We offer a range of options, including silicone and saline implants in various shapes, sizes, and profiles. We also offer fat transfer breast augmentation for those seeking a modest size increase using their own body fat. Our board-certified surgeons will guide you through the choices during your consultation, helping you select the best option to meet your aesthetic goals and complement your body frame.

procedure_recovery.heading: Procedure and Recovery
paragraphs: The procedure involves placing the implant either behind the breast tissue or beneath the chest muscle through a discreet incision. Our focus is on creating a result that is both beautiful and proportional, ensuring your new silhouette looks natural and feels right for you. Recovery typically involves a few days of rest, with a return to most non-strenuous activities within a week or two. The results are immediate and long-lasting, providing a significant boost to self-esteem.
